name: player receiving yards count season threshold 1000
description: The count aggregator at season period: counts seasons clearing the threshold rather than games. Pairs with the game-period fixture to cover both registered count tuples.
expected_query: with "per_period_season_77d231189ed0" as materialized (select "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", nfl_games.season_year AS period_key, nfl_plays.target_pid AS pid, SUM(CASE WHEN nfl_plays.is_completion = true THEN nfl_plays.receiving_yards ELSE 0 END) AS m_2205f2f1663c from "nfl_plays" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "nfl_plays"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2021, 2022, 2023) and not "nfl_plays"."play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') group by nfl_plays.target_pid, nfl_games.season_year, "nfl_games"."season_year"), "per_period_summary_3dd684731763" as materialized (select "per_period_season_77d231189ed0"."pid", "per_period_season_77d231189ed0"."year", COUNT(DISTINCT per_period_season_77d231189ed0.period_key) FILTER (WHERE per_period_season_77d231189ed0.m_2205f2f1663c >= 1000) AS s_f793eb42c67b from "per_period_season_77d231189ed0" group by "per_period_season_77d231189ed0"."pid", "per_period_season_77d231189ed0"."year") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, MAX(per_period_summary_3dd684731763.s_f793eb42c67b) AS rec_yds_from_plays_0, "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join "per_period_summary_3dd684731763" on "per_period_summary_3dd684731763"."pid" = "player"."pid" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
